test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'RACE' is written as 'WFHJ' and 'TRAP' is written as 'YWFU'. How will 'FROM' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/OJ1Uh2duioUDR2SH1M7mmAE_vdtyeruVwDyUvxFmKsN-3_Km8phHI2sPLB7XN0iDIls49ZHtD6_M-ON_owI3STrtaOCPT3r_q4uJYashVxWwv2AIAMHilb5T7YwF_R31e8Dy-La4FVkCDMReKO1rN2ZrIudphVakkdbeZjCm91tgT1SER8sY5_wK8E9d] 

'RACE' is written as 'WFHJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/566ff99c75de75d60ec63b81b846eae1e14a832df008ab005380094568ddf123.png] 

And,

'TRAP' is written as 'YWFU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70777ef1f62f23b87c58c95b6f80a60fc9caf7a8bd8e2746fd5ea55654876057.png] 

Similarly,

'FROM' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af603cb7d76d5977eb1cb2b0cb2a8b107a7151fa864dcc0e85009520a3608f15.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**KWTR**".
